definitions.alignment: Equal user/item token sets, explicitly reordered to the original frozen catalog; no IDs are published.
definitions.canonical_array_hash: SHA256 of sorted-key JSON shape/dtype metadata, NUL, and C-order little-endian float64 values.
definitions.file_hash_interpretation: NPZ byte equality is distinct from numerical array equality and recommendation equality.
definitions.full_ranking_difference: Different positions in the complete eligible ordering, plus per-item absolute rank displacement.
definitions.no_accuracy_claim: No relevance labels are opened; identical top10 order implies identical top10 rank metrics under any fixed truth.
definitions.numeric_scope: All saved score cells including PAD and seen items; eligible-only statistics separately exclude both.
definitions.ranking_scope: All 943 users per expert; candidates exclude TRAIN observations and PAD, retaining VALID eligibility.
definitions.tie_rule: Descending score then original catalog index, using stable sorting.
definitions.top10_substitution: Number of original top10 items missing from rebuilt top10, summed over users.

scope: Independent numerical and ranking agreement of 45 completed rebuilt experts
